claims.statement: Within one frozen bearer/event/consumer/route/response/time/signature slice K, a valid Boolean relation-use by present-fit 2x2 exists iff independently witnessed valid actual tokens realize all four values in the image of (R,F).
claims.domain: Actual event tokens in one declared invariant slice with Boolean R and F.
all_premises: witness independence from assignment labels and response endpoint
claims.proof: The codomain {0,1}^2 has four elements; a valid full crossing is exactly surjectivity onto that codomain, equivalently image cardinality four.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Four trial labels can coexist with one actual state; non-Boolean or graded factors need a revised criterion.

claims.statement: If present fit is a single-valued Boolean function of retained-relation use throughout one invariant slice, at most two actual factor pairs are reachable, so the full 2x2 is not installed there.
claims.proof: The graph of a function from a two-element domain has at most two ordered pairs.
claims.counterexamples_limits: An admissible compensator may break the dependence; this is not a universal impossibility claim.

claims.statement: A compensator that changes the enacted event, current consumer, constitutive route or response meaning does not fill a missing cell in the original slice; pooling across the changed invariant slices is a different comparison.
claims.proof: Changed K partitions tokens into different domains; surjectivity must hold within one domain.
claims.counterexamples_limits: An invariant-preserving compensator can be admissible but still needs off-target accounting.

claims.statement: Assignment or questionnaire labels cannot establish factorial fidelity: four nominal cells can coexist with one actual (R,F) state when witnesses echo labels rather than the event.
all_premises: response endpoint excluded as the sole fidelity source
claims.proof: The exact label-echo model has four assignments, one actual image value and no valid witnessed crossing.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Independent noisy witnesses can be used with a declared error model; perfection is not required by this finite counterexample.

claims.statement: The current archive contains no actual physical same-bearer four-cell installation with independent pre-outcome R and F fidelity; the active pure-candidate factorial comparison is terminated at NOT_INSTALLED rather than extended with more calibration layers.
claims.domain: A4A and A4H-A4K records at the verified A4L baseline.
all_premises: software/finite models are not physical bearer admissions
questions and intervals are not actual factor states
claims.proof: Artifact-level inspection finds zero admitted physical tokens and therefore zero valid actual cells under A4L-C1.
claims.counterexamples_limits: A future bounded apparatus could open a new application; termination is record- and candidate-specific.

claims.statement: Factorial installability, retained-relation use, present fit, J_cont, H_cont, complete organization and basal experience remain distinct; A4L neither calibrates mineness nor alters C1/U1.
claims.domain: UCT interpretation of A4L-C1 through A4L-C5.
claims.proof: Concept, quantifier, scope and inference-direction audit.
claims.counterexamples_limits: A later actual application still needs complete bearer binding and an independently justified phenomenal bridge.
